Bindings for hb-icu.h (HarfBuzz 14.2.1).

Links -lharfbuzz-icu. Needs ICU headers (unicode/uscript.h) at compile time; covered by pkg-config harfbuzz-icu cflags.

UScriptCode generated from unicode/uscript.h (ICU 78.3). Do not hand-edit. Aliased codes (UCAS, MANDAEAN, MEROITIC, PHONETIC_POLLARD, SINDHI, DUPLOYAN_SHORTAND) are const aliases below the enum.

hb_common, hb_unicode
